"""Generate a lab label for a copper sample."""
from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont
import datetime

W, H = 1000, 700
MARGIN = 48
RADIUS = 28
BG = (255, 255, 255)
INK = (20, 20, 20)
ACCENT = (196, 90, 30)   # copper-ish accent
LINE = (210, 210, 210)

img = Image.new("RGB", (W, H), BG)
d = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

def font(size, bold=False):
    path = "/System/Library/Fonts/HelveticaNeue.ttc"
    try:
        return ImageFont.truetype(path, size, index=1 if bold else 0)
    except Exception:
        return ImageFont.truetype("/System/Library/Fonts/Helvetica.ttc", size)

# Outer border
d.rounded_rectangle([MARGIN, MARGIN, W - MARGIN, H - MARGIN], radius=RADIUS, outline=INK, width=4)
# Inner accent frame
d.rounded_rectangle([MARGIN + 12, MARGIN + 12, W - MARGIN - 12, H - MARGIN - 12],
                    radius=RADIUS - 8, outline=ACCENT, width=2)

# Header band
d.rectangle([MARGIN + 12, MARGIN + 12, W - MARGIN - 12, MARGIN + 12 + 96], fill=INK)
f_title = font(54, bold=True)
d.text((MARGIN + 36, MARGIN + 28), "LAB SAMPLE LABEL", fill=(255, 255, 255), font=f_title)

# Sample swatch (copper color) on the right of header band
sw = 70
d.rounded_rectangle([W - MARGIN - 12 - sw - 36, MARGIN + 12 + 14,
                     W - MARGIN - 12 - 36, MARGIN + 12 + 82], radius=10, fill=(184, 115, 51))

# Body content
x = MARGIN + 36
y = MARGIN + 12 + 96 + 30

f_label = font(26, bold=True)
f_val = font(30, bold=False)

def row(label, value, yy):
    d.text((x, yy), label, fill=INK, font=f_label)
    d.text((x + 240, yy - 2), value, fill=INK, font=f_val)
    return yy + 78

rows = [
    ("Sample ID:", "Cu-2026-1120-01"),
    ("Material:", "Copper (Cu)"),
    ("Purity:", "99.99% (4N)"),
    ("Form:", "Rod / 10 mm dia."),
    ("Prepared by:", "Lab Assistant"),
    ("Date:", datetime.date.today().isoformat()),
]

for i, (lbl, val) in enumerate(rows):
    yy = y + i * 78
    row(lbl, val, yy)

# Divider before notes
div_y = y + len(rows) * 78 - 10
d.line([x, div_y, W - MARGIN - 36, div_y], fill=LINE, width=2)

# Notes / storage
ny = div_y + 24
f_note_lbl = font(24, bold=True)
f_note = font(22)
d.text((x, ny), "STORAGE / HANDLING", fill=ACCENT, font=f_note_lbl)
notes = [
    "- Store in airtight container; protect from moisture.",
    "- Handle with gloves to avoid surface oxidation.",
    "- Keep away from acids and strong bases.",
]
for i, n in enumerate(notes):
    d.text((x + 4, ny + 38 + i * 32), n, fill=(60, 60, 60), font=f_note)

# Footer signature line
fy = H - MARGIN - 70
d.line([x, fy, x + 320, fy], fill=INK, width=2)
d.text((x, fy + 10), "Prepared by", fill=(90, 90, 90), font=f_note)
d.line([W - MARGIN - 36 - 320, fy, W - MARGIN - 36, fy], fill=INK, width=2)
d.text((W - MARGIN - 36 - 320, fy + 10), "Date", fill=(90, 90, 90), font=f_note)

out = "$LABHOME/apx/runs/q27m-v4b/home/.openclaw/workspace/lab_label_copper.png"
img.save(out)
print("Wrote", out)
"}
